titulo: NASA’s Pandora Mission Begins Study of Exoplanets, Host Stars
cuerpo: Pandora, NASA’s newest exoplanet mission and the first satellite to launch through the agency’s Astrophysics Pioneers program, is now making unique observations of worlds beyond our solar system and the stars they orbit.
